feature: join of shapes that touch along an edge, then a whole-shape round
note: round() of a joined handle: the interpreter may refuse it (whole-shape round is for box and cylinder)
source: const a = box(20,20,20,{at:[0,0,0]}); const b = box(20,20,20,{at:[20,20,0]}); const j = join(a,b); round(j, 2)
frontEndErrors: Rounding works on a shape, not a combination. Round the shapes before you join them.
refusalSentence: Rounding works on a shape, not a combination. Round the shapes before you join them.
summary: interpreter: Rounding works on a shape, not a combination. Round the shapes before you join them.
